extraction_notes: BZT52B5V6 VZ range at IZT = 0.005 A is 5.49 V minimum, 5.60 V nominal, and 5.71 V maximum at TA = 25 degC.
BZT52B5V6 maximum zener impedance is 40 ohm at IZT = 0.005 A and 400 ohm at IZK = 0.001 A.
Typical temperature coefficient at IZTC is -2.0 mV/degC minimum and 2.5 mV/degC maximum; admissible zener current IZM is 0.005 A.
The zener and capacitance plots are family-level typical curves; plotted points are manual digitizations and are not guaranteed limits.
omission_reason: Reverse-recovery data is not published. The capacitance value is available only from a family-level typical plot, not a part-specific table.
